summary: The new-generation, boxy Haval H7 plug-in hybrid arrived in October 2026 in two AWD grades, Lux at $50,990 and Vanta at $53,990 drive-away, pairing a 33.7kWh LFP battery with a 320kW Hi4 system for a 4.9-second 0-100km/h claim. Australian launch reviewers (CarExpert, RACQ, RACV, CarsGuide) agree it is strong value and that the PHEV is the pick of the range over the hybrid, but mark down a fidgety ride on rough roads, numb steering, awkward lane-assist and the lack of an ANCAP rating at launch. GWM claims 137km of electric range, but the same Hi4 variant is rated 129km WLTP in Europe.
pros: About 129-137km of electric range from a 33.7kWh LFP pack (129km WLTP for the Hi4 in Europe, GWM AU claims 137km), well beyond the H6 PHEV's 106km NEDC claim, for $50,990 drive-away
320kW/670Nm Hi4 dual-motor AWD with a claimed 4.9-second 0-100km/h, plus a mechanical locking rear differential and 210mm ground clearance on both grades
Seven-year/unlimited-km vehicle warranty with no servicing condition, eight-year/unlimited-km cover on the drive battery, and seven years of capped-price servicing at $460 a visit
DC charging 30-80 per cent in about 19 minutes and up to 6kW of V2L output, both uncommon at this price
Claimed 586L boot and 1404L folded, ahead of the BYD Sealion 6's 425L, with a full-size spare on the tailgate
cons: With a flat battery GWM's own figure is 7.5L/100km in a 2150kg SUV, so the 0.9L/100km label is meaningless for a buyer without home charging; CarExpert saw 6.1L/100km in hybrid mode
Towing is limited to 1500kg braked on both grades, half the 3000kg of GWM's Tank 300 PHEV, so it suits a small trailer rather than a caravan
The boot is shallow with a high load floor and no underfloor storage (RACQ, RACV), the side-hinged tailgate is heavy and manual, and the external spare limits rear vision
No ANCAP rating at launch, and reviewers flag awkward lane-keeping assistance, numb steering and a fidgety ride on rough roads
GWM's 137km range claim comes from internal testing; the same Hi4 variant is rated 129km WLTP in Europe
